exposure: Ropivacaine dosage (10mg, 5mg, 4mg, and 3mg) for subarachnoid block in cesarean section
outcome: Pre- and post-anesthesia stress and inflammatory responses
finding: Administration of 4 mg hyperbaric ropivacaine in subarachnoid block can achieve an optimal anesthesia effect in cesarean section with a high level of safety, along with inducing mild abdominal wall muscle relaxation and attenuating stress and inflammatory responses.
